name: Summer Youth Job Training Program (SYJTP) 2027
org: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government, Partners for Youth
what_you_do: Work part time at a summer job site for six weeks. The city pays your wages. You go to skills sessions in winter and spring, a career fair and orientations first.
who_can_apply: Lexington youth who will be in grade 10, 11 or 12. The page gives no age range and no more residency rules.
pay_detail: $15 per hour, up to 20 hours a week
deadline_text: The page says registration is open. No deadline is posted. Skills sessions run virtually from January to March.
how_to_apply: Sign up with the online form. To get first pick for a summer job, finish the online Skills Sessions. Also go to the Career Fair, Verification Clinic, Parent Orientation and Youth Worker Orientation.
notes: Partners for Youth is at 162 E. Main St., Suite 210, Lexington, KY 40507. Phone 859-280-8006. The page does not say whether a work permit is needed. Ask the office.
